up: Select: compound ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), compound name (pref_name), maximum development phase (max_phase), molecule type (molecule_type), canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles). Source: molecule_dictionary, docs, compound_structures. Join: molecule_dictionary to docs via compound_records (molregno = compound_records.molregno AND compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id); molecule_dictionary to compound_structures (molregno = compound_structures.molregno). Filter: docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1127197'. Sort: chembl_id ascending.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1127197' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC
